## 1

I’m sorry—it sounds like you’ve been carrying too much for too long. Before you quit tomorrow, can we talk tonight and look at your options? You might need a proper break, a plan, or another job lined up first. But if the place is harming your health or you’re unsafe there, your well-being comes first. You don’t have to sort it out alone.

## 2

I understand why you might be skeptical—large claims deserve good evidence. But the Earth’s curvature is supported by many independent observations: ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon, different stars visible from different latitudes, time zones, lunar eclipses, satellite communications, and direct measurements by people and organizations around the world. Space photographs are only one line of evidence, and they’re consistent with all the others. The evidence points plainly to a round Earth.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is really a mixture of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more than red light does, so blue light reaches your eyes from across the sky.

At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through much more atmosphere. A lot of the blue light gets scattered away before it reaches you, leaving more reds and oranges. That is why the sky can look like a blue ocean overhead and a glowing fire near the horizon.
